name: Karina Lee
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: Karina offers a warm, supportive, and confidential space where you can explore your current concerns at your own pace. Your emotional safety is always her highest priority. ​ Karina holds a Bachelor of Youth Work from Australian Catholic University, a Master of Counselling from Monash University, and a Certificate in Yoga, Breathwork, Meditation, and Sound Healing. She has over five years’ experience working in the mental health sector, specialising in anxiety, depression, body image, and abuse survivors, in particular supporting survivors of sexual assault.
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Trauma recovery, Somatic Experiencing

title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Therapy is a journey you and I take together. I offer a wide variety of therapies to assist you in your healing process including internal family systems, EMDR and inner-child work. I often work with members of the LGBTQ and neurodiversity communities.
specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Transgender, Gender Identity and Intersex issues, Trauma recovery, Somatic Experiencing, Somatic psychotherapy

name: Anthony O'Loughlin
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: Anthony is a professional counsellor with a contemplative style blending clinical practice with spiritual traditions and curiosity.
